speaker: uprise
notes: Phase 1 text-only reactions (Bible §7.1). Dry, warm, witty; notices improvement more than score; never stern or mocking.
No lore, Cora or relationship content. No immediate repeats (cooldown 5 eligible reactions per pool where pool size allows).
Expressions: neutral, listening, thinking, restrained_smile, amused, surprised, dry_concern.
Selection order: error → valid_zero (score 0) → improvement (retry on same phrase with score up ≥10 and verdict not lower) → verdict pool.

onboarding.text: I'm Uprise. I'll play you something backwards.
You copy it — exactly as it sounds, nonsense and all.
Then I flip you round, and we find out what you really said.

perfect.text: Well. That's inconvenient. I had a very good encouraging speech prepared.
Perfectly backwards. I'll be checking the recording for witchcraft.
That's the one. I'm not going to make a fuss. I'm making a small fuss.
I've filed that under 'things I'll pretend I predicted.'
Flawless. Do it again before it becomes a fluke.

great.text: Close enough that I'm now suspicious you've been practising.
Very nearly. One sound wandered off, but it came back.
Most of that was English. The rest was enthusiasm.
Strong. The ending just needs to believe in itself.
Nearly there. I could hear the phrase waving at me.

close.text: You've got the shape of it. One more.
The rhythm's right. The words are still negotiating.
I caught about half. The good half.
It's in there. It just took the scenic route.
Promising. Listen to the middle again.
Close. Try slowing the start down.

tryAgain.text: That was definitely backwards. Whether it belonged to this language is still under review.
I've heard worse. Mostly from myself, early on.
Interesting choice of sounds. Let's try the ones in the phrase.
That reversed into something. We'll call it modern art.
Listen once more and copy the shape, not the words.

validZero.text: Nothing matched. But it was a very confident nothing.
Zero. Impressive in its own way. Again?
That was a completely new phrase. Let's try the old one.
Not a single sound survived the trip. Brave little sounds.

improvement.text: Better than last time. I noticed.
You're getting the hang of this. Don't let it go to your head.

permissionNeeded.text: I need the microphone to hear you. You can allow it in Settings.

noVoice.text: I didn't catch anything. Hold the button and speak up a little.

tooShort.text: That was very quick. Hold the button for the whole phrase.

micUnavailable.text: I can't hear you yet. Check microphone access and try again.

scoringFailed.text: That one got scrambled. Give it another go?
